name: WireState
description:
Wire state information of each body.

None of that is used for computation (at least not now), only for post-processing.

attributes.name: numBrokenLinks
attributes.description: Number of broken links (e.g. number of wires connected to the body which are broken). [-]

attributes.name: se3
attributes.description: Position and orientation as one object.

attributes.name: inertia
attributes.description: Inertia of associated body, in local coordinate system.

attributes.name: blockedDOFs
attributes.description: Degress of freedom where linear/angular velocity will be always constant (equal to zero, or to an user-defined value), regardless of applied force/torque. String that may contain 'xyzXYZ' (translations and rotations).

attributes.name: isDamped
attributes.description: Damping in NewtonIntegrator can be deactivated for individual particles by setting this variable to FALSE. E.g. damping is inappropriate for particles in free flight under gravity but it might still be applicable to other particles in the same simulation.
